chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Hasan ibn 'Ali ibn Yaqtin, from his brother al-Husayn, from 'Ali ibn Yaqtin, who said:
I asked Abā al-Ḥasan Mūsā عليه السلام about a woman who dies while her child in her womb is moving. He said: "An incision is made for the child."

key_terms.الْمَرْأَةِ: the woman in question in the legal case
key_terms.الْوَلَدِ: the child to be taken out
key_terms.تَمُوتُ: dies; the occurrence of death forming the basis of the ruling
key_terms.فِي بَطْنِهَا: in her womb; indicating the child is still unborn
key_terms.وَوَلَدُهَا: and her child; the unborn baby in her womb
key_terms.يَتَحَرَّكُ: is moving; showing signs of life
key_terms.يُشَقُّ: it is cut open; an incision is made

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a pregnant woman dies while the child in her womb is still moving?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a deceased pregnant woman whose child is still moving in her womb. Imam Mūsā عليه السلام states that the body should be opened for the child, indicating a ruling tied to preserving the life of the unborn child in such a case.
